title: Saving Our Forests
desc: 每一棵树，都是对未来的一个小小承诺。

vocab.en: a large area of land covered with trees
vocab.ex: Forests cover about a third of the land on Earth.
vocab.exZh: 森林覆盖了地球上约三分之一的陆地。

vocab.en: the gas in the air that we need to breathe
vocab.ex: Forests give us the oxygen we breathe.
vocab.exZh: 森林为我们提供呼吸所需的氧气。

vocab.en: to stop existing or to be no longer seen
vocab.ex: When a forest disappears, those animals lose their home.
vocab.exZh: 当一片森林消失，那些动物就失去了家园。

vocab.en: the usual weather of a place
vocab.ex: Trees help control the climate by taking in carbon dioxide.
vocab.exZh: 树木通过吸收二氧化碳来调节气候。

vocab.en: to keep someone or something safe
vocab.ex: Many countries are now trying to protect the forests they still have.
vocab.exZh: 许多国家现在都在努力保护它们仅存的森林。

vocab.en: to put a plant into the ground to grow
vocab.ex: One person can plant a tree and care for it.
vocab.exZh: 一个人也可以种一棵树并照料它。

en: Forests cover about a third of the land on Earth, and they give us the oxygen we breathe.
They are also home to more than half of the world's land animals and plants.
When a forest disappears, those animals lose their home, and we lose a part of our planet's life.
zh: 森林覆盖了地球上约三分之一的陆地，为我们提供呼吸所需的氧气。
它们还是世界上超过一半陆地动植物的家园。
当一片森林消失，那些动物就失去了家园，我们也失去地球生命的一部分。

en: Trees help control the climate by taking in carbon dioxide, the gas that warms our planet.
Cutting down too many trees makes the air warmer and the rain less regular.
That is why many countries are now trying to protect the forests they still have.
zh: 树木通过吸收二氧化碳来调节气候，这种气体会使我们的星球变暖。
砍伐太多树木会让空气变暖、降雨变得不规律。
这就是为什么许多国家现在都在努力保护它们仅存的森林。

en: Protecting a forest is not only the work of governments; one person can plant a tree and care for it.
Schools and towns are planting trees together, and children learn why the forest matters.
Every tree we plant is a small promise to the future.
zh: 保护森林不只是政府的工作；一个人也可以种一棵树并照料它。
学校和城镇正在一起种树，孩子们也从中了解森林为什么重要。
我们种下的每一棵树，都是对未来的一个小小承诺。
